purpose: Preserve non-qualifying provenance for an intentionally stopped exact-binary core soak without treating partial runtime as release evidence.

qualification_status.reason: A deletion audit found that authenticated whole-run delete_local incorrectly required a fully acknowledged upload. An offline or partially uploaded run could therefore become permanently undeletable after the platform had already fenced and erased its remote copy.

partial_observation.verdict_scope: Historical diagnostic observation only. Duration was short and the tested binary was invalidated; none of these counters qualify a release.
